title: Capture

[[File:SMO Art - Goomba Capture.png|thumb|200px|Artwork of Mario '''capturing''' a Goomba.]] '''Capture''' is a unique ability that [[Mario]] gains in ''[[Super Mario Odyssey]]''. His newfound hat friend, [[Cappy]], grants him this power when Mario first visits the [[Cap Kingdom]]. When Cappy is thrown at certain enemies, creatures, or objects, such as [[Goomba]]s, Mario is able to take control of said enemy, creature, or object. This allows Mario to use new abilities, many of which he has never previously had, and collect [[Power Moon]]s which would normally be out of his reach. When capturing something, that thing will gain Mario's hat and mustache, as well as blue pupils or his irises (if it has eyes). Mario can also "de-capture" his host at will (by pressing {{button|ns|zl}}), stunning them for a while. However, if an enemy or other being wears a hat or something similar on its head, Mario can only capture it after knocking the hat by jumping onto it or throwing Cappy. {{br}} ==Capture list== {| class="wikitable" |- !# !width=1%|Capture !Description !Controls |- !01 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Frog Capture.png|100px]]

{{button|ns|B}} Jump
''Shake the {{button|ns|joy-con}} Joy-Con/{{button|ns|pro}} Pro Controller to High Jump.'' |- !02 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Spark pylon Capture.png|100px]]

He can also "de-capture" the pylons at any point, allowing him to drop onto objects below him and reach some otherwise unreachable areas. If there are collectible objects like [[Coin]]s or a [[Power Moon]] close to a power line, Mario can leave the power line to collect them, this is done by pressing the {{button|ns|y}} button at the right time. |{{button|ns|leftstick}} Move
''You can also shake the {{button|ns|joy-con}} Joy-Con/{{button|ns|pro}} Pro Controller to move.'' |- !03 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Paragoomba Capture.png|100px]]
[[Paragoomba]] |Mario can capture a Paragoomba and use it to fly over bottomless pits of fog. |{{button|ns|B}} Fly
''Shake the {{button|ns|joy-con}} Joy-Con/{{button|ns|pro}} Pro Controller to fly faster.'' |- !04 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Chain Chomp Capture.png|100px]]
[[Chain Chomp]] |Mario can capture a Chain Chomp and pull back on its chain in order to have it fly off in the opposite direction. This allows him to destroy rocks and other obstacles that Mario could otherwise not destroy himself. |Pull {{button|ns|leftstick}} to Wind Up
Release {{button|ns|leftstick}} to Send Flying |- !05 |style="text-align:center;"|[[File:SMO Big Chain Chomp Capture.png|100px]]
